support.matches.title: Match issues

support.account.body: From Profile you can edit your details, sign out and access privacy, terms and account deletion.
delete.title: Account deletion
delete.body: Your Firebase identity, profile, photo, availability and associated matches will be deleted. You must have signed in recently.
delete.supportBody: If you cannot access the account, write from the associated email to support@puchica.uk. We will verify your identity before processing the request.
delete.confirmTitle: Are you sure you want to delete your account?
delete.confirmBody: Your profile, photo, schedules, scores, reviews and matches will be deleted. You cannot recover them.
delete.finalBody: This action is permanent. Your scores and competitive history will also be deleted.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: MatchPoint Tennis is an app for finding tennis players, organizing matches and participating in rankings, teams, leagues and tournaments.
privacy.data.title: Data we process
privacy.data.body: Account and authentication; sports profile; photo; club and availability; approximate location when requested; proposals and bookings. Results, reviews and rankings will only be processed when those features are enabled.
privacy.purpose.title: Purpose
privacy.purpose.body: We use this data to identify your profile, find compatible rivals, match schedules and organize matches. When competitive features are enabled, it will also be used to validate results and calculate standings.
privacy.location.title: Location
privacy.location.body: Location is requested contextually to sort nearby players and open routes to clubs. We do not sell location data or use it for advertising.
privacy.providers.title: Providers
privacy.providers.body: Google Firebase provides authentication, database and hosting. Google and Apple process sign-in when you choose those providers.
privacy.visibility.title: Visibility
privacy.visibility.body: Other authenticated users can see your name, photo, club, level, languages, availability, statistics and sports ratings required for the community to work.
privacy.retention.title: Retention and rights
privacy.retention.body: We keep the information while your account is active. You can edit it, request a copy, or start deleting your account and associated data from Account.
privacy.contact.title: Controller and contact
privacy.contact.body: Controller: Pedro Caparrós Torres. For privacy, support or exercising your rights: support@puchica.uk.
terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.platform.title: Use of the platform
terms.platform.body: You must provide truthful information, respect other players, and use proposals, teams, leagues and tournaments only for legitimate sporting purposes.
terms.results.title: Results and standings
terms.results.body: Results only affect standings after validation. Administration may correct fraud, duplicates, impersonation or abusive conduct.
terms.safety.title: Safety
terms.safety.body: Each player is responsible for assessing where and with whom they play. The platform facilitates contact and does not replace personal safety measures or each club's rules.
terms.availability.title: Service availability
terms.availability.body: The current version is in development and may change. Commercial and monetization terms will be communicated before any payment is enabled.
terms.contact.title: Contact
terms.contact.body: Responsible: Pedro Caparrós Torres. Support and legal inquiries: support@puchica.uk.
